title: Point on the Stack
goal: Enable bitwise copy on a small struct to remove unnecessary clone calls.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 2 Afternoon: Copy Types

hints: Deriving Copy allows p1 to be duplicated automatically on assignment or function calls.
When a type is Copy, passing p1 directly duplicates it without moving ownership.
explanation: Deriving `Copy` alongside `Clone` enables bitwise copy semantics for small value types like `Pos`. Passing `p1` by value then copies bytes instead of moving ownership, so `p1` remains valid for subsequent calls without calling `.clone()`. Passing `&p1` causes type mismatch `E0308` because `print_pos` expects an owned `Pos`.
